tools.name: decode_token
tools.description: Decodes a JWT without verifying it and shows header and claims. Example: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiIxMjM0NTY3ODkwIiwibmFtZSI6IkpvaG4gRG9lIn0.SflKxwRJSMeKKF2QT4fwpMeJf36POk6yJV_adQssw5c. Also decodes base64, e.g. SGVsbG8sIHdvcmxkIQ== decodes to 'Hello, world!'.
